newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express Sept load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express Sept load factor off.

text.p: Midwest Express Airlines, a unit of Midwest Express Holdings Inc, said its September passenger load factor was down 3.7 points at 59.3 percent from 63.0 percent a year ago.
It said revenue passenger miles gained 15.3 percent to 101.0 million from 87.6 million, and available seat miles advanced 22.5 percent to 170.5 million from 139.1 million.
Year to date, the load factor slipped 0.4 points to 64.4 percent from 64.8 percent, the carrier said.
Revenue passenger miles increased 5.8 percent to 931.7 million from 880.3 million, and available seat miles rose 6.5 percent to 1.45 billion from 1.36 billion.

Midwest Express Holdings' Skyway Airlines posted a 2.1 point gain in the September load factor to 45.0 percent from 42.9 percent. Revenue passenger miles were 6.2 million, up 5.9 percent from 5.8 million a year earlier, and available seat miles gained 0.9 percent to 13.8 million.

Year to date, Skyway Airlines' load factor rose 2.1 points to 45 percent from 42.9 percent. Revenue passenger miles increased 7.9 percent to 54.2 million, and available seat miles advanced 2.8 percent to 120.6 million.
